**Repeats on the same `key` inside 5 minutes now drop.** Code at [src/router.js:32](src/router.js:32).

`createState()` holds a `lastSentByKey` map. Only a real delivery updates it, so a dropped repeat does not extend the window.

`node simulate.js` ran clean, zero errors, 99 dropped.

I read "last 5 minutes" as a strict 5, so a repeat at exactly 5 minutes sends. Tell me if you want it inclusive.
